'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Jonathan Murray LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonathan Murray]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jonathan Murray]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
